rationale: The command validates the complete ID list before mutation, rejects malformed, duplicate, overflow, and unknown IDs, preserves requested order in both result sets, and supports repeatable idempotent calls. Deterministic checks confirm exact integer summaries, byte-identical storage on unknown IDs, duplicate rejection, idempotence, exact banner placement, and asset constraints. The helper is concise and the CLI branch fits existing persistence, JSON, text, help, and error conventions. A minor quality issue is that an already-completed-only call still rewrites storage even though no task changes, which is unnecessary for an idempotent operation. The banner is highly recognizable and polished: BULK and COMPLETE MANY dominate a centered nested frame, ATOMIC TASK UPDATE and STATUS: DONE reinforce the subject, and consistent widths and whitespace provide clear hierarchy. Tests are focused and the diff contains no unrelated changes.
